## Projects

- [Industrial Predictive Maintenance & Telemetry Alerting](https://github.com/mireiaacss/predictive-maintenance-alerts): Random Forest failure prediction from industrial sensor telemetry (3.3% failure rate across 10,000 records), 0.98 ROC-AUC. Failure probability is mapped to early-warning tiers; an LLM (Llama 3.1 via Groq) writes a diagnosis and an n8n workflow alerts the operator on Telegram. Stack: Python, scikit-learn, Streamlit, n8n.
- [AI Maintenance Tool for Solar Panels](https://github.com/mireiaacss/solar-dust-analysis): fine-tuned Vision Transformer (ViT) that classifies dust soiling on solar panels with a confidence score, followed by a Llama 3.3 70B layer that estimates the monetary loss from power degradation. Local Gradio app with no image persistence. Stack: PyTorch, Hugging Face, Gradio.
- [Costa Rican Household Poverty Vulnerability Analysis](https://github.com/mireiaacss/costa-rican-household-poverty-prediction): multiclass poverty-tier models stalled at 0.42 macro-F1 due to structural class overlap; a three-way feature selection framework (correlation, mutual information, Random Forest importance) isolated 17 predictors, and reframing as binary triage reached 0.81 ROC-AUC with Logistic Regression and a household-level stratified split to prevent leakage.
- [Privacy-Preserving Customer Acquisition (Federated Learning)](https://github.com/mireiaacss/federated_learning): Federated Averaging across three bank nodes, sharing only model weights; node-local SMOTE and F1-tuned thresholds for an 88/12 class imbalance; 0.90 ROC-AUC with zero raw records shared. Streamlit dashboard compares federated and centralised training.
- [Quantum-Ready Portfolio Optimiser](https://github.com/mireiaacss/quantum_portfolio_optimiser) (exploratory): cardinality-constrained Markowitz portfolio selection formulated as a QUBO Hamiltonian, Ledoit-Wolf covariance shrinkage, D-Wave Neal simulated annealing compared with classical baselines.
